description: `activity broadcast` (hub-only — HUB_PROJECT_NAME is the literal string 'multiverse', not configurable) leaves one message in every project [activity.pairs] permits. Decided change 2 (`20261108-b-81cb2b`): a configured `multiverse` project is now implicitly activity-paired with every other project in both directions, so the `multiverse = ["project-a"]` grant below no longer leaves project-b unreachable — both leaves are 'sent' and the fan-out is no longer partial. The scenario id and its original 'partial fan-out' framing predate that change and are kept rather than renamed, so the id stays a historical label, not a description of today's behavior. Pure file I/O — no herdr call anywhere on this path.
